purpose: Migration manifest only; all 51 source facts and evidence URLs have been merged into canonical catalog site rows.
nonOverwritePolicy: Does not replace or rewrite resources.json, resources_2.json, the 199-site canonical catalog, or the 51-site expansion catalog.
rules: Never infer a numerical grade, purity, reserve or coordinate from a generic country/commodity average.
Keep unknown fields explicitly UNOBSERVED or UNQUANTIFIED.
Grade is ore/commodity concentration, not refined-product purity.
Reserve and resource classes must retain the source reporting framework and effective date when available.
Map coordinates from this dataset are copied from the expansion catalog and retain their coordinateStatus; they are not survey-grade by default.
Real-world operational status is descriptive metadata only and does not directly set gameplay extraction output.

sourceStandards.name: USGS Mineral Resources Data System
sourceStandards.use: Global deposit identity, commodity, geology, references; quality varies and systematic updates ceased in 2011.

sourceStandards.name: Global Energy Monitor Global Coal Mine Tracker
sourceStandards.use: Coal mine identity, status, type, grade categories and source-defined reserve/resource classifications.

sourceStandards.name: Global Energy Monitor Global Oil and Gas Extraction Tracker
sourceStandards.use: Asset-level oil/gas field identity, location, ownership, status and reserves; production fields excluded from this overlay.

sourceStandards.name: CRIRSCO International Reporting Template
sourceStandards.use: Mineral resource/reserve classification and disclosure principles.

researchAudit.coverageSummary: Field-level numeric coverage and explicit source gaps are stored per canonical site row. Do not use a duplicate aggregate count from this migration manifest.
researchAudit.notes: Unknown values remain explicit; gameplay-only capacity, reserve and production profiles are stored separately in SCENARIO_SIMULATION_DATA.
